title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 2.83 (versions follow prime numbers; 283 after 281): a double click, and each one names their own Razar. The GitHub release carries Janax-Razar-Windows.zip: 'Arrancar Janax.exe' (a 2.6 KB launcher written by hand in FASM: it finds its folder, tells the kernel where the house is, starts the kernel with her body), janaxos.exe, her body assembled by Janax's own PDP assembler, and her house (books, heart, what she learned reading), without her name and without the private talks: each Razar asks its name to whoever launches it. Found on the way: the kernel names its paths with '/'. Also: she never says exactly what she already said (she crosses it and says it new); her open mind improvises with any of her books; she learns from whoever talks to her. Stated: the package is for Windows and carries her body already assembled; Razar's imagination is not yet joined to her improvising. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v2.83: doble clic, y cada uno le pone el nombre a su Razar. Prototipo de investigación.
